shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.bodyHtml:
Shipping and Delivery Policy

Effective Date: January 13, 2025

Label AshB is committed to delivering your orders safely and clearly. This policy explains our shipping coverage, dispatch timelines, delivery estimates, tracking process, and what to do if there is an issue with your order.

Contact Us

For shipping and delivery queries, contact us at:

Email: sales@labelashb.in
Phone/WhatsApp: +91 98107 25683

1. Order Processing and Delivery Timelines

Ready-to-ship items

Ready-to-ship items are dispatched within 2 working days and delivered within 3-5 business days.

Made-to-order/customized pieces

Made-to-order/customized pieces may take 2-3 weeks depending on the design.

We will notify you once your order is dispatched and share tracking details where available.

2. Shipping Coverage

Domestic shipping within India

We ship across India and offer free standard shipping on dress orders within India.

International shipping

International orders are shipped via DHL Express or another suitable courier partner, with charges calculated at checkout or confirmed before dispatch where required.

Import duties, customs duties, clearance charges, and local taxes are the customer's responsibility.

3. Shipping Partners

We use trusted courier partners based on delivery location, service availability, and product type. Courier partners may include Delhivery, Blue Dart, India Post, DTDC, DHL, FedEx, or other suitable carriers.

4. Delivery Estimates

Delivery timelines are estimates and may vary due to courier delays, public holidays, festivals, weather conditions, remote locations, customs clearance, or other unforeseen circumstances.

Label AshB is not responsible for delays caused by courier partners, customs authorities, incorrect address details, or circumstances outside our control.

5. Shipment Tracking

After dispatch, tracking details will be shared by SMS, email, WhatsApp, or through your order/account page where available.

Tracking updates may include order confirmed, in production for made-to-order/customized pieces, dispatched, out for delivery, and delivered.

6. Multiple Items in One Order

If your order includes multiple items, they may be shipped together once all items are ready.

If your order contains both ready-to-ship and made-to-order/customized pieces, the full order may be shipped together after the made-to-order/customized pieces are ready.

If you would like ready-to-ship items delivered earlier, contact us at sales@labelashb.in or WhatsApp +91 98107 25683. Split shipment may be possible, and additional shipping charges may apply.

7. Delivery Address

Please provide a complete and correct delivery address, including full name, house or flat number, street address, landmark if needed, city, state, pin code, and phone number.

If you need to change your address before dispatch, contact us immediately. Once an order has been dispatched, address changes may not be possible and may need to be handled directly with the courier partner.

8. Failed Delivery Attempts

Courier partners usually make multiple delivery attempts. If delivery fails because the customer is unavailable, the address is incorrect, or the parcel is refused, the order may be returned to us.

Re-delivery or re-shipping charges may apply if the parcel is returned due to incorrect address details, failed delivery attempts, or refusal of delivery.

9. Cash on Delivery

Cash on Delivery availability may depend on location, order value, product type, and courier availability.

Cash on Delivery is not available for international orders and may not be available for customized or high-value orders.

10. International Shipping

International delivery timelines vary by destination and courier service. Customs clearance may add extra time beyond the courier estimate.

Customers are responsible for all applicable import duties, customs duties, local taxes, and clearance charges. If a customer refuses to pay applicable customs charges or refuses delivery, shipping charges and any return costs may be deducted from any eligible refund.

11. Missing, Damaged, or Incorrect Orders

If your order arrives damaged, incorrect, or with missing items, contact us within 48 hours of delivery at sales@labelashb.in or WhatsApp +91 98107 25683.

Please provide your order number, clear photos, and an unedited unboxing video. Keep the original packaging and tags intact and do not wash or use the item.

Once verified, we will arrange the appropriate resolution, which may include replacement, exchange, or other support depending on the issue.

12. Undelivered or Returned Orders

If an order is returned to us because it could not be delivered, we will contact you using the phone number, email, or WhatsApp details provided with your order.

Re-shipping charges may apply before the order is dispatched again.

13. Contact Us

For shipping and delivery questions, contact us:

Email: sales@labelashb.in
Phone/WhatsApp: +91 98107 25683
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.bodyHtml:
CANCELLATION AND REFUND POLICY

Effective Date: January 13, 2025

At labelashb.in, we want you to love your purchase. This policy explains our cancellation, return, exchange, and refund terms.

CONTACT US For cancellations, returns, or refunds: Email: sales@labelashb.in Phone/WhatsApp: +91 9810725683 Address: 1030, Sector 17B, Gurugram, Haryana 122001, India

1. ORDER CANCELLATION

Before Dispatch (Ready Stock Items):

  • Orders can be cancelled within 12 hours of placing the order

  • Contact us immediately at sales@labelashb.in or WhatsApp +91 9810725683

  • If order has not been processed, we will cancel and issue a full refund

  • Refund will be processed within 5-7 business days

After Dispatch:

  • Once an order is dispatched, cancellation is not possible

  • You may refuse delivery, but return shipping charges will apply

  • Refund will be processed after we receive the item in original condition

Made-to-Order/Customized Items:

  • Customized orders CANNOT be cancelled once production begins

  • We will notify you when production starts

  • No refunds for customized items unless defective

2. RETURNS AND EXCHANGES

Return Window: 7 days from delivery date

Eligible for Return/Exchange:

  • Ready stock items in original condition

  • Unused, unworn, unwashed with all tags attached

  • Original packaging intact

  • Proof of purchase (order confirmation email or invoice)

NOT Eligible for Return/Exchange:

  • Made-to-order or customized items

  • Items without tags or in used condition

  • Intimate wear or undergarments (hygiene reasons)

  • Products damaged due to misuse

  • Sale/clearance items (unless defective)

Defective or Wrong Item Received:

  • Contact us within 48 hours of delivery

  • Provide photos/videos of defect or wrong item

  • We will arrange free return pickup

  • Full refund or replacement provided

How to Initiate a Return:

  • Step 1: Contact us within 7 days at sales@labelashb.in

  • Step 2: Provide order number, reason for return, and photos (if applicable)

  • Step 3: We will send return instructions and courier pickup details

  • Step 4: Pack item securely in original packaging

  • Step 5: Courier will pick up from your address (charges may apply - see below)

Return Shipping Charges:

  • Defective/Wrong Item: FREE return pickup arranged by us

  • Change of Mind/Size Issue: Customer pays return shipping (Rs. 100-200 depending on location)

  • We will deduct return shipping cost from refund amount

3. REFUND PROCESS

Refund Timeline:

  • After receiving returned item: 2-3 business days for inspection

  • Refund approval: Within 24 hours of inspection

  • Refund credited: 5-7 business days after approval

Refund Method:

  • Original payment method (same card/UPI/wallet used for purchase)

  • For COD orders: Bank transfer (provide bank details)

Refund Amount:

  • Full product price refunded (for defective items)

  • Product price minus return shipping (for non-defective returns)

  • Shipping charges are non-refundable (unless we shipped wrong/defective item)

Refund Deductions:

  • Return shipping: Rs. 100-200 (if applicable)

  • Restocking fee: 10% (for non-defective returns - only if item is opened/tags removed)

4. EXCHANGE POLICY

We accept exchanges for:

  • Size issues (subject to stock availability)

  • Color/style preference (within 7 days)

Exchange Process:

  • Contact us within 7 days

  • Return original item (customer pays return shipping)

  • We will ship replacement item once we receive and inspect returned item

  • If replacement is higher price, customer pays difference

  • If replacement is lower price, no refund of difference

5. DAMAGED IN TRANSIT

If item arrives damaged:

  • Report within 48 hours with unboxing video/photos

  • Email sales@labelashb.in

  • We will file claim with courier

  • Full refund or replacement provided

  • No return shipping charges

6. WRONG SIZE ORDERED BY CUSTOMER

  • Exchanges allowed (customer pays return shipping)

  • No refunds for wrong size selection by customer

  • Please refer to our Size Chart before ordering

7. NON-REFUNDABLE ITEMS

  • Customized/personalized orders

  • Sale/clearance items (unless defective)

  • Intimate wear/undergarments

  • Items without tags or in used condition

8. PROCESSING TIME

  • Return approval: 24 hours after we receive item

  • Refund processing: 5-7 business days

  • Bank credit: Additional 3-5 business days (depending on bank)

9. CONTACT FOR ASSISTANCE

We are here to help with any return/refund questions: Email: sales@labelashb.in Phone/WhatsApp: +91 9810725683 Hours: Monday-Saturday, 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM IST

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.bodyHtml:
PRIVACY POLICY

Effective Date: January 13, 2025 Last Updated: January 13, 2025

labelashb.in ("we", "us", "our") operates the website www.labelashb.in (the "Site"). We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our Site or make a purchase.

CONTACT INFORMATION If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: Email: sales@labelashb.in Phone: +91 9810725683 Address: 1030, Sector 17B, Gurugram, Haryana 122001, India

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT

a. Personal Information You Provide:

  • Name, email address, phone number

  • Billing and shipping address

  • Payment information (processed securely via Shopify Payments and third-party payment gateways)

  • Account login credentials

  • Communications with us (emails, WhatsApp messages, customer support inquiries)

b. Automatically Collected Information:

  • IP address

  • Browser type and version

  • Device information

  • Pages visited and time spent on Site

  • Referring URLs

  • Cookies and tracking technologies (see Cookie Policy below)

c. Third-Party Sources: We may receive data from:

  • Google Analytics (website traffic analysis)

  • Facebook/Instagram Pixel (advertising)

  • Payment processors (Razorpay, PayPal, Stripe)

2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

We use your personal information to:

  • Process and fulfill your orders

  • Process payments and send invoices/order confirmations

  • Arrange shipping and delivery via courier partners

  • Provide customer support

  • Send marketing communications (only with your consent - you can opt out anytime)

  • Prevent fraud and screen orders for potential risk

  • Improve our website, products, and services

  • Comply with legal obligations (tax, accounting, consumer protection laws)

3. LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING

We process your data based on:

  • Consent: When you opt-in for marketing emails or newsletters

  • Contractual Necessity: To fulfill your orders and process payments

  • Legitimate Interests: Fraud prevention, website analytics, customer service

  • Legal Obligations: Compliance with Indian tax laws, GST regulations, Consumer Protection Act

4. HOW WE SHARE YOUR INFORMATION

We DO NOT sell your personal data. We may share it with:

Service Providers:

  • Shopify (e-commerce platform)

  • Payment gateways (Razorpay, PayPal, Stripe, COD processors)

  • Shipping/courier partners (Delhivery, Blue Dart, India Post, etc.)

  • Email/SMS service providers

  • Google Analytics, Facebook Ads

Legal Authorities:

  • If required by law, court order, or government request

  • To protect our rights, property, or safety

5. DATA RETENTION

We retain your personal data for as long as:

  • Your account is active

  • Necessary to provide services

  • Required by law (e.g., tax records: 7 years in India)

You can request deletion of your account/data at any time by emailing sales@labelashb.in.

6. YOUR RIGHTS

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data

  • Correct inaccurate information

  • Request deletion of your data

  • Withdraw consent for marketing communications

  • Object to processing for marketing purposes

  • Request a copy of your data (data portability)

To exercise these rights, email: sales@labelashb.in

7. COOKIES POLICY

What Are Cookies? Cookies are small text files stored on your device by websites to track activity and preferences.

Types of Cookies We Use:

a. Strictly Necessary Cookies:

  • Enable website functionality (shopping cart, checkout, login)

  • Cannot be disabled

b. Performance/Analytics Cookies:

  • Google Analytics: Tracks website usage and visitor behavior

  • Helps us improve user experience

c. Functional Cookies:

  • Remember your preferences (language, currency)

  • Improve site usability

d. Advertising/Targeting Cookies:

  • Facebook Pixel, Google Ads: Show relevant ads based on browsing behavior

  • Track conversions and ad performance

Third-Party Cookies: We use cookies from:

  • Google (Analytics, Ads)

  • Facebook/Instagram (Pixel for ad tracking)

  • Payment processors

Managing Cookies:

  • Accept or reject cookies via the banner on first visit

  • Clear cookies through browser settings

  • Opt out of targeted advertising: Google Ads Settings, Facebook Ad Preferences

Cookie Duration:

  • Session cookies: Deleted when browser closes

  • Persistent cookies: Remain for 30 days to 2 years

8. SECURITY MEASURES

We use:

  • SSL encryption (secure HTTPS connection)

  • Secure payment gateways (PCI-DSS compliant)

  • Access controls and password protection

  • Regular security audits

However, no method of online transmission is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

9. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY

Our Site is not intended for children under 13 years. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If we discover such data, we will delete it immediately.

10. INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS

Your data may be stored and processed outside India (e.g., Shopify's servers in the US/Canada). We ensure such transfers comply with applicable data protection laws.

11. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date. Please review regularly.

12. CONTACT US

For questions, complaints, or data requests: Email: sales@labelashb.in Phone: +91 9810725683 Address: 1030, Sector 17B, Gurugram, Haryana 122001, India

Availability:

  • If an ordered item is unavailable, we will notify you and offer: Full refund, or Substitute product (with your approval)

5. PRICING

  • Prices include GST (Goods and Services Tax) where applicable

  • Price at time of order placement applies (not cart addition time)

Pricing Errors:

6. PAYMENT

Accepted Payment Methods:

  • UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm)

  • Net Banking

  • Cash on Delivery (COD) - India only, up to Rs. 25,000

Payment Security:

  • We do not store your card details

  • PCI-DSS compliant payment processing

Failed Payments:

7. ORDER CONFIRMATION

After placing order, you will receive email confirmation. Confirmation does not guarantee product availability. We reserve the right to cancel orders if product is out of stock, pricing error occurred, payment issue detected, or fraudulent activity suspected.

8. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

Copyright and Trademarks:

  • Protected by copyright and trademark laws

  • You may not copy, reproduce, or distribute content without permission, or use our brand name or logo without authorization

Product Designs: All product designs are proprietary. Unauthorized reproduction is prohibited.

9. PROHIBITED USES

You agree NOT to: use Site for illegal purposes, impersonate any person or entity, upload malicious code or viruses, attempt to hack or disrupt Site functionality, scrape or harvest data from Site, use automated bots, make fraudulent purchases, abuse customer service team.

Violation may result in account termination, legal action, reporting to authorities.

10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

labelashb.in is NOT liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, loss of profits or revenue, data loss, third-party claims, courier delays or lost shipments (beyond our control), damage due to misuse of product.

Maximum Liability: Limited to purchase price of product.

11. WARRANTY DISCLAIMER

Products are sold "AS IS": we do not guarantee products are error-free or defect-free, we are not liable for minor variations in handmade products, fabric colors may fade over time with use/washing (normal wear and tear).

We DO provide refund/replacement for manufacturing defects (within 7 days) and customer support for product issues.

12. RETURNS AND REFUNDS

See our "Cancellation and Refund Policy" for details. Summary: 7-day return window for ready stock items, no returns for customized/made-to-order items (unless defective), customer pays return shipping (unless item is defective).

We are not liable for failure to perform due to natural disasters (floods, earthquakes, pandemic), war, terrorism, civil unrest, government actions or restrictions, strikes or labor disputes, courier service disruptions, internet/technology failures.

14. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION

These Terms are governed by laws of India. Courts of Gurugram, Haryana have exclusive jurisdiction. Any disputes will be resolved in Gurugram courts only.

15. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

If you have a complaint: Step 1: Contact us at sales@labelashb.in. Step 2: We will attempt to resolve within 7 business days. Step 3: If unresolved, you may file complaint with Consumer Forum.

16. CHANGES TO TERMS

We may update these Terms: Changes posted on this page. "Last Updated" date will reflect changes. Continued use of Site = acceptance of new Terms.

17. SEVERABILITY

If any provision of these Terms is found invalid, that provision will be modified to minimum extent necessary. Remaining provisions remain in full effect.

18. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

These Terms constitute entire agreement between you and labelashb.in regarding use of Site.

19. CONTACT US
